name: 极简科技风
description: 克制科技、结构清晰、信息层次丰富。
prompt: Design: Deep charcoal background (#111111) with crisp white and cool blue accents. Typography: bold sans-serif hierarchy with a large title, short subtitle, compact metrics, and small labeled modules. Layout: Use a rich but restrained composition with a main title, 2-3 supporting data chips, thin connector lines, and an abstract technical diagram. Keep all critical visual content in the upper 72% of the 16:9 canvas and leave the bottom 18-22% as a clean subtitle-safe zone with no important text or objects. Animation: smooth slide-up, staggered line drawing, soft number count-up, subtle parallax. Video-optimized: legible at mobile size, no tiny labels, no scrollbars, avoid empty title-only frames.

name: 赛博终端黑客风
description: 终端界面、HUD 扫描、信息密度高。
prompt: Design: True black background (#000000) with neon green (#00FF66) and cyan (#00D8FF) accents. Typography: monospace terminal style with large command headline, status rows, data panels, scan grid, signal waveform, and protocol chips. Layout: Create a layered HUD interface instead of a plain terminal; include 3-5 readable information blocks and animated system lines. Keep critical content above the lower subtitle-safe zone: no important labels, cursors, charts, or focal elements in the bottom 18-22% of the 16:9 canvas. Animation: typewriter reveals, scanning beam, blinking cursor, panel boot sequence, small glitch cuts. Video-optimized: high contrast, no tiny decorative code, no scrollbars.

name: 优雅学术纪录片
description: 经典刊物排版、知识图谱、权威叙事。
prompt: Design: Warm off-white background (#FDFBF7) with charcoal text, muted olive, ink blue, and fine editorial rules. Typography: elegant serif display title paired with clean sans-serif captions. Layout: Build an editorial documentary frame with a title, chapter label, short abstract, timeline or annotation strip, and 2-3 diagram callouts. Keep the main title, diagram, and annotations in the upper 72% of the canvas; reserve the bottom 18-22% as subtitle-safe negative space. Animation: soft fade, slow Ken Burns scale, rule drawing, annotation pins appearing in sequence. Video-optimized: refined, readable, richer than a single title page, no small unreadable footnotes.

name: 动力学完播风
description: 快节奏、强冲击、短视频吸睛。
prompt: Design: High-energy saturated background using bright yellow, black, white, and one bold accent color. Typography: extra-bold sans-serif or Impact-style words mixed with stickers, arrows, progress bars, and punchy callouts. Layout: Use a dynamic collage with a large headline, 2-3 supporting punch phrases, motion arrows, burst shapes, and a retention progress motif. Keep all big words and visual anchors above the bottom subtitle-safe zone; never place key text in the bottom 18-22% of the canvas. Animation: elastic pop-ins, fast word-by-word reveals, swipe cuts, bounce highlights, progress pulse. Video-optimized: readable, energetic, rich composition without clutter.

name: 数据杂志风
description: 商业图表、编辑式数据故事、清爽专业。
prompt: Design: Clean editorial data visualization style with white background, graphite text, cobalt blue, coral, and lime accents. Typography: bold editorial sans-serif title with compact chart labels. Layout: Present a business insight like a magazine spread: headline, key number, bar/line chart, comparison cards, legend, and one explanatory callout. Keep the lower 18-22% of the canvas mostly empty for subtitles; charts and key numbers must sit in the upper 72%. Animation: chart bars grow, line path draws, cards slide in, key metric counts up. Video-optimized: clear hierarchy, no dense spreadsheet text, no bottom subtitle overlap.

name: 产品蓝图风
description: 分层拆解、产品结构、步骤讲解。
prompt: Design: Blueprint-inspired explainer with soft midnight background, cyan grid lines, off-white panels, and warm amber highlights. Typography: modern sans-serif with technical labels and concise step captions. Layout: Show a product, workflow, or concept as layered cards connected by arrows: main object, 3 feature modules, numbered steps, and a small status rail. Keep the composition lifted: important panels, labels, and arrows stay above the bottom subtitle-safe zone, leaving the lower 18-22% visually quiet. Animation: blueprint lines draw, modules expand, arrows trace paths, feature cards flip or slide. Video-optimized: rich but organized, readable labels, no tiny engineering annotations.
